The '''Lode Star Utopia''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located within the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], administrators of the Lode Star Utopia chose to remain neutral, and thus rarely fired on any [[Starship/Legends|starship]] without provocation.
